In 1933, five men in New York took out life insurance on a homeless drunk named Michael Malloy.
then tried to kill him for the payout.
It started when a broke bar owner gave Malloy an unlimited tab.
figuring he'd drink himself to death in a week.
Instead, Malloy drank nonstop and felt great.
So, they swapped his liquor for pure antifreeze.
And every morning he woke up asking for another pour.
Running out of money, they stuffed a sandwich with rotten sardines and metal carpet tacks.
Maloy ate the whole thing and asked for seconds.
So, they gave up on bar tricks and paid a cab driver to run him over at 45 miles an hour.
Three weeks later, he walked right back through the doors.
They finally killed him with a gas hose while he slept.
and only got caught because they couldn't stop bragging around town about the man who wouldn't die.
